data.name: Voxelaxy [Remastered]
data.detailed_description:
Voxelaxy [Remastered]

Hello Astronauts! After almost 3 years and a big break on Voxelaxy, I've come back with the biggest Update Voxelaxy has ever seen.
I've rewritten everything to bring you new gaming experience! The old game in a new Remastered Version!
For those who have Voxelaxy (it's free - it's just an update), for those who are new, there is a fantastic price!
Welcome to the new era of Voxelaxy!


Voxelaxy (the combination of two words: Voxel & Galaxy) is a space survival game. The spaceship, which he calls ''Mouse'', has been destroyed suddenly by a missile. He had to land in an emergency on the Unknown Planet. Using only a limited set of tools, you have to survive in a hostile environment. Crafting oxygen and finding food seems almost impossible... Are you ready?

The Unknown Planet

You have landed on The Unknown Planet.
Are you ready for colonizing your own planet on your own terms?
What's your plan for the economical use of land?
Remember, the map never ends!

Key features:
  • Voxel graphics-style.
  • Randomly, infinite procedurally generated worlds.

reviews.review:
[h1]In a pixel[/h1]

We play as an astronaut which spaceship has been destroyed by a missile, fortunately we land on a planet which some tools to build or main base and be ready to cover all our needs in a hostile environment.

We start slowly going down into the ground next to a few boxes in a 3x3x3 formation a bunch of stuff that we will give use in the whole game, we will establish our base by putting every object in the ground, being able to rotate the objects as we wish, you can move stuff any way that you want after you have it in the ground.

Before starting be sure of taking a look to both visual and written tutorial since most aspects of the game will be very well explained there, any moment in the game, pressing F1 we can see all the tutorials again.

One of our main items is the drill, we can use that to mine different resources as well as drill bits, but this, as well as almost all the items in the game, need a power source  of a required amount of Volts and in this case a drill bit, that can be broken after using the drill too much, Every object requires a different power source, a drill require 9V, a furnace 240V and so on. We can always craft more batteries of different Volts if we need to.

When you are placing stuff the game slows you down big time and it takes slow the same to move a furnace than a plant pot. The other thing that may be weird is that the direction that you are facing with the mouse is the direction that the W key moves you forward.

We have several conditions that we have to watch out, hunger, thirst, health points, stamina and oxygen, all of them will kill you slowly at different frequencies of time.

We will have to use a lamp at night that throws off a surprising but necessary amount of light to illuminate our base, we also have the possibility to craft an infinite amount of lamps as long as we got the resources.

After finishing establishing your base it will probably be night already so you will have to start getting out of there and go mining in the middle of the night because no batteries can be charged during the day and we may face some enemies during our exploration so we should have our light saber equipped, as well as our drill to mine everything we find, after our first expedition we just put everything we found on the furnace.

Once we get our alchemy table we will be able to craft water and oxygen bottles, as well as fertilizer and seeds, essential for survival. The main resource to craft all this tables is the steelite and can be found easily in the background while exploring, and this is one of the first thing to do since oxygen will be the first thing we run out of.

[b]Content & Prices [/b]
Price is pretty close to 6 euro with 35% discount, seems like a reasonable price for the content and for having multiplayer, maybe not so worth to buy without discount unless it keeps getting updated.

[b]Multiplayer [/b]
The multiplayer is the best thing that the game can offer, since playing with someone else will allow us to assign task to each other and organize a base way faster than in singleplayer.

The bad news is that we need some kind of program or vpn to create the servers and
that makes people not try the multiplayer cause I guess that is a bit complicated.
 
[b]Graphics[/b]
Simple graphics and background not very detailed to be honest, the only backgrounds are mountains and ores that are repeated over and over across the whole map with some meteorites that will fall near your location sometimes.

[b]AI [/b]
AI is pretty bad, there are enemies but those die with two hits with the most basic weapon and deal very low amount of damage, the only use at the moment for the creatures is that after being defeated they may drop some useful resources that cannot be crafted.

[b]Bugs [/b]
A few sound bugs can be found when you alt+tab the game the music just cut and sometimes alt-tabbing again will recover the sound or restart another soundtrack

[h1]Pros[/h1]

   ● Different crafting tables
   ● Possibility to build wherever you want
   ● Multiplayer and coop option
   ● Very well explained tutorial


[h1]Cons[/h1]

   ● Multiplayer is kind of hard to play, couldnt find anyone to play with yet

[h1] Overall thoughts [/h1]

I have really enjoyed playing this game in singleplayer and will play again in multiplayer when the game catch more people because it's fun and worth it.
